trajectory.patch:
The compilation errors are caused by incorrect handling of code that depends on the `CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER` Kconfig option. When this option is disabled due to unsatisfied dependencies on some platforms, the variable `test_fcb_crc_disabled` is not defined, leading to build failures.

The fixes are:
1.  Correct the `CMakeLists.txt` file to properly remove `fcb_test_crc_disabled_after_enabled.c` from the build when `CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER` is disabled. The `list(REMOVE_ITEM ...)` command was missing the list name (`app_sources`).
2.  Add a preprocessor conditional (`#if defined(CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER)`) around the test case in `fcb_test_append.c` that uses the `test_fcb_crc_disabled` variable. This ensures the code is only compiled when the required Kconfig option is enabled.

tests/subsys/fs/fcb/CMakeLists.txt
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
if(NOT CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER)
  list(REMOVE_ITEM "src/fcb_test_crc_disabled_after_enabled.c")
endif()
========
if(NOT CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER)
  list(REMOVE_ITEM app_sources "src/fcb_test_crc_disabled_after_enabled.c")
endif()
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
tests/subsys/fs/fcb/src/fcb_test_append.c
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
ZTEST(fcb_test_crc_disabled, test_fcb_append_crc_disabled)
{
	test_fcb_append(&test_fcb_crc_disabled);
}
========
#if defined(CONFIG_FCB_ALLOW_FIXED_ENDMARKER)
ZTEST(fcb_test_crc_disabled, test_fcb_append_crc_disabled)
{
	test_fcb_append(&test_fcb_crc_disabled);
}
#endif
